description: The two Presse-fotos pages confirm the 8 January Copenhagen demonstration at Christiansborg Slotsplads and generic freedom/choice wording, but give no human crowd number and no specific domestic state-policy demand. S009 repeats and links to S008, so it is not independent.

description: The root interim coordinator decision selects one national Student Rebellion ’22 event with E003 as representative, E004 as linked location evidence and X001 as conditional context. It is based on one movement, common national demand and three-city actions; do not add local estimates. The worker’s separate local records remain preserved as raw evidence, and official/final batch approval remains pending.
required_followup: Retain the root interim episode decision separately from the raw worker records. Preserve each city count and attribution without sums or duplicate event counts; reopen the unit only if final review or source admissibility materially changes the evidence.

description: For E001, the police report says the procession returned at 21:45 with fewer people but does not state the physical end; fireworks-related charges do not establish arrests or a response to the protest demand. S013 confirms the Aarhus target but supplies no response evidence. For the 12 January city actions, sources establish the date and locations but not exact start/end times, route or state response. Silence is not coded as ignoring the protest.
required_followup: Seek contemporary police, organizer or government records for E001’s physical close and any attributable arrest or dispersal attempt, and for the Jan 12 chronology and response. Keep unsupported end and response fields unknown.

description: Uniavisen reports about 20–25 students in Odense. Under the root’s interim choice of one national Jan 12 event, X001 is conditional local-threshold context, not a standalone exclusion. The 20–25 count is below 50 only if a separate Odense assembly is selected as the unit.
required_followup: Preserve X001 and the Odense count as a linked local observation under the current national-unit choice; reconsider only if final review changes that unit choice. Do not sum the three city estimates or count Odense separately under the current choice.

description: The English Uniavisen S010 article is a translated counterpart of Danish S005, not independent confirmation. Omnibus S002 is an advance article from the same outlet as event report S004. description: Boundary leads include December 18, 2021 demonstrations (S007), a planned February 9 Student Rebellion ’22 event (S011), and an unrelated February protest lead concerning foreign troops (S012). description: Discovery captured 34 English- and Danish-language web searches covering month-wide and weekly windows, major cities, student/labor/Covid/climate/land/price/rights/police topics and month boundaries. This is open-web discovery, not a systematic LexisNexis or equivalent hemeroteca review and not proof of exhaustive spatial, sectoral or source coverage.
